voice_060:r_77949221bf58f862.text: I'll squeeze you nice and tight!

voice_060:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: I'll slaughter every one of you!

voice_060:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: All right! I'll give you a beating!

voice_060:r_f7570547e9f80a64.text: Kan Yu's command is never wrong!

voice_060:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: Don't think you can beat me!

voice_060:r_e20bfd42ad95a3c9.text: I'll smack that smug face of yours!

voice_060:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: I'll crush you in one fell swoop!

voice_060:r_6dbcc507fb61b51d.text: Brave of you not to run!

voice_060:r_15b4a90140e8a33a.text: You dare target the great Kan Yu?!

voice_060:r_af884a6b11dff121.text: Fool! You dare take aim at me?!

voice_060:r_ac6fe7838e95647b.text: Regret this plenty in the afterlife!

voice_060:r_77ca87eacd17ad52.text: Whoa there! You're not getting away!

voice_060:r_bf3244994760e535.text: You can't escape my watchful eye!

voice_060:r_aabfb21c9d069ce7.text: You! Trying to steal my prey?!

voice_060:r_02479dc8fe989560.text: Move! I can't leave this to you!

voice_060:r_48b60d6c48b9b142.text: I can't counter?! What's going on?!

voice_060:r_8927e6fb681aa809.text: What was the supply unit doing?!

voice_060:r_a571eec59b258d11.text: That works on others, but not me!

voice_060:r_faae935cca0edc72.text: And you actually meant to hit me?!

voice_060:r_d4430bf362340b32.text: Hahaha! Now you know my power!

voice_060:r_6ff1323b355593e0.text: Rue this all you like! Fwahahaha!

voice_060:r_36133ad73a73ef98.text: Hmph! That won't work on me!

voice_060:r_3633df5b7b8f47fa.text: You're not even worth my time.

voice_060:r_52dfc56b14b93551.text: Hmph. No need to check the damage.

voice_060:r_1b9b2aab5cb104da.text: You think that's enough to beat me?

voice_060:r_719e897304ec42d4.text: You think that will make me flinch?

voice_060:r_d5e0a2317c40d322.text: You insolent cur... You disgust me!

voice_060:r_ec2ea17765052401.text: You dare defy me? You've got nerve!

voice_060:r_f2d4255f1c2f7542.text: Damn you... I won't forgive this!

voice_060:r_5d08ad19e2da125b.text: You'll pay for what you've done!

voice_060:r_a7246b52782a877e.text: What do you think you're doing?!

voice_060:r_dc8701f6bcb9904f.text: Th-this has to be some mistake!

voice_060:r_9e0c80ac7e33b459.text: Damn it! Stay out of my way!

voice_060:r_065443f6ddfcf0d7.text: I've no use for small fry!

voice_060:r_847f82e7f3eef651.text: I have tricks like this too!

voice_060:r_eb7ae28b53dc033c.text: Tch! Always making me clean up!

voice_060:r_857c4a52ce8df0fd.text: I'll beat that twisted attitude out!

voice_060:r_7d724dbcc4451e10.text: Learn the terror of opposing me!

voice_060:r_93e25418a203cb8f.text: I'll crush the pest right in front!

voice_060:r_adeb0a29274d3d9b.text: The perfect prey, just as I thought!

voice_060:r_24cf161287ef9d5c.text: I'll never forget how you shamed me!

voice_060:r_8f60f6fc86db3107.text: My old grudge ends here and now!

voice_060:r_b1de76a75a253c13.text: If it weren't for you lot, I'd...!

voice_060:r_5213c17e13b23de0.text: All of this was to get my revenge!

voice_060:r_38fdff9483e9245c.text: I'll live, even if I must eat dirt!

voice_060:r_620fedec67706d7d.text: I'm nothing like I was before!

voice_060:r_9680dcd0fddcfcc7.text: Even a Balarant AT,\nI'll master it!

voice_060:r_3dbeead1bd3164ef.text: Since I met you\nmy life fell apart!

voice_060:r_98d15b8cc09bc915.text: You jinx! I'll personally end you!

voice_060:r_ac341e7976e88f0b.text: I'll expose that Nextant as a fraud!

voice_060:r_cfccaa1fbeda124c.text: Time to repay that old debt!

voice_060:r_b1f8ec192b9c083a.text: An AS is no match for an AT!

voice_060:r_a007f9ab9cf048b3.text: Bag a Gundam\njobs will pour in!

voice_060:r_ddafde4b065ced49.text: Big oaf! I'll take you down a peg!

voice_060:r_0c0775e051211840.text: I'll run you through with this!

voice_060:r_a2afffe1c396f0b3.text: I'll skewer you right in your seat!

voice_060:r_c958860b0676b1f5.text: I'll twist your torso clean off!

voice_060:r_6825fd1ff907bd22.text: Allow me to assist you, Niva!

voice_060:r_9b9726b1872759d6.text: Like your attack could ever hit me!

voice_060:r_ad3d538f1e909184.text: Chirico! So this is your best!

voice_060:r_b84afafb8a33ec60.text: Damn it! Still an insolent lot!

voice_060:r_c8c59db85bf875e6.text: Damn you! Damn you, damn youuu!

voice_060:r_391aa56435d9dd6e.text: Why?! Why does this always happen?!

voice_060:r_640327a12a559b31.text: N-no! The power gap is too great!

voice_060:r_bdd38c584fa313d0.text: N-no! It's too fast to keep up!

voice_060:r_ceb935ccbf830724.text: Raaagh! Why's it always like this?!

voice_060:r_862ef7385bf2abd4.text: I-I won't die! I'll never die!!

voice_060:r_001cbec4d9a4283f.text: Niva, it's time to pause the game.

voice_060:r_8ad40afecd02b41e.text: It's also an order from above.

voice_060:r_26e5efec03c03d78.text: A soldier need only follow orders!

voice_060:r_4ad81e88c7557a8b.text: Too excited and fainted? Big oaf!

voice_060:r_40c5a9358ed5bf29.text: I'll take point, so be grateful!

voice_060:r_f2e18dfdfe0c89ea.text: I don't need you to tell me!

voice_060:r_fa96676cc65bb509.text: Damn it! Don't order me around!
